Attaching a draft MAP and a lightweight scorecard — file contains proposed owners, milestone dates, and a suggested canary metric set. Key notes up-front:

- Recommended canary: 2-week initial window with a 72-hour warmup. Acceptance = avg token latency < 220ms and error rate < 0.8% over a 24h rolling window.
- Migration approach: staged data sync (nightly incremental -> final delta at cutover) + DNS cutover with 1-hour rollback window.
- Training: two 60-min train-the-trainer sessions + five 45-min office hours during the first two weeks post-canary.

Please review owners in column E and flag any conflicts. Elaine — procurement items are called out on page 2 (billing dates and invoice milestones).

Marissa
